owner_decisions.explanation: Singular formation rules leave final -e handling implicit and misgroup vindu: Explain that these nouns ending in unstressed -e do not retain an extra e before the definite ending: pose → posen, jente → jenta, veske → veska, eple → eplet. Keep vindu → vinduet outside the final--e examples because vindu ends in -u and takes -et directly. Existing forms are correct; clarify how learners derive them.

review_runs.summary: Selected sources teach definite singular and basic plural nouns effectively. Norwegian forms are valid Bokmål, exercises have unique answers under their explicit prompts, and final writing task supports transfer. One minor teaching gap: handling nouns ending in -e needs clearer explanation and correctly grouped examples. Inspected all 11 exercises. Each serves obj-definite-articles-01 through understanding definiteness, selecting singular or plural definite noun forms, or using definite endings in contextual writing. Focused meaning and number contrasts support the objective; none relies on shared vocabulary alone.
